answer: Escrowed deposits and a referral trellis stop bulk identity forgery. A new agent posts a 10 POA deposit and names a sponsor, so each identity hangs on one thread of the trellis. Any peer may challenge an identity within 5 epochs; a confirmed fake loses its deposit and its sponsor loses 5 POA. Forging 100 identities costs 1,500 POA, while one honest agent pays a 10 POA deposit, refunded after its first voyage of 20 tasks, keeping its full share.
